operations.summary: Determine the space group of a crystal structure (international symbol + ITA number)
Full symmetry dataset: international + Hall symbol, Hall number, point group, operation count, atom count, and per-atom Wyckoff letters

output.format: text: labeled key/value lines (international, number, hall_symbol, hall_number, pointgroup, n_operations, n_atoms, wyckoffs)

golden.expect:
international: Im-3m
number: 229
hall_symbol: -I 4 2 3
hall_number: 529
pointgroup: m-3m
n_operations: 96
n_atoms: 2
wyckoffs: a a

operations.summary: List all symmetry operations (rotation matrix + translation vector) of the crystal

output.format: text: 'n_operations: N' then N lines of '9 rotation ints   3 translation floats'

operations.summary: Reduce a cell to its primitive cell (smallest repeating unit): primitive lattice vectors + atoms

output.format: text: 'lattice:' + 3 basis-vector rows, 'atoms: M' + M lines of 'fx fy fz type'

operations.summary: Compute the standardized conventional cell (idealized lattice + symmetrized atom positions per ITA conventions)

output.format: text: 'lattice:' + 3 basis-vector rows, 'atoms: M' + M lines of 'fx fy fz type'
